name: cy-corporate-tax
description: Cyprus corporate income tax for tax year 2026: companies resident in Cyprus (managed and controlled in Cyprus, or incorporated in Cyprus unless a treaty says otherwise) and Cyprus permanent establishments of foreign companies. Covers the 15% rate from 1 January 2026 (Law 244(I)/2025), the taxable base, the dividend and securities-gains exemptions, notional interest deduction, IP box, the 7-year loss carry-forward, 75% group relief, interest limitation (30% EBITDA, EUR 3m), provisional tax on 31 July and 31 December, the IR4 return, penalties, Special Defence Contribution as it stands for 2026 (deemed distribution kept only for 2024 and 2025 profits) and withholding on outbound payments. Trigger on: Cyprus corporate tax, 15% Cyprus, IR4, TD4, provisional tax Cyprus, deemed dividend distribution, NID Cyprus, Cyprus group relief. Out of scope: individuals (cyprus-income-tax), domicile and SDC for individuals (cy-non-dom), VAT (cyprus-vat-return), payroll (cyprus-payroll), social insurance
